final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS number_of_orders FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, CAST(number_of_orders AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(number_of_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM customer_orders), gaps AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, number_of_orders, share, gap_above_average FROM gaps WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
